notes.title: Cannibal ALPHA 0.7

tags.feature: New NPCs that will support new missions.
Multi-map navigation system (V0.8 the player can travel to other maps) "delayed"
New hud in collecting items when using the pick (only in the cave).

tags.bug: (Pickaxe and Axe) Click the left mouse button several times to knock down a tree or break a rock;
(Furnace and Workbench) Still appears in the craft system but has been disabled;
(Pickaxe and Axe) It is only necessary to hold the left mouse button to repeat the activity;
(Furnace and Workbench) Items and resources can now be traded with new NPCs (cave area - location displayed with the "E" key);

tags.feature: HUDs will be updated to be more intuitive;
Map: possibility to travel to other maps (city, cannibal base);
New missions;
Possibility to restore vehicles and control drones to complete objectives;
Improvement in the start menu (Language, volume ...).

notes.title: Cannibal ALPHA 0.6

tags.feature: [*]New start to the game;
[*]Multi-map navigation system (V0.7 the player can travel to other maps);
[*]Adding keyboard map, accessed by inventory (keyboard icon);
[*]Added fixed location in base for craft furnace and workbench;
[*]Improvement system of the base must be accessed by the inventory (second item in the craft tab).

notes.title: CANNIBAL - Alpha 0.4

tags.feature: Craft of pickaxe: to collect rocks and iron;
Craft of furnace: to produce charcoal and metal;
Craft workbench: now the survivor can make equipment such as grenades, rifles and others;
Visual of HUDs, getting more functional and intuitive (work in progress);
Mining sector to collect material;
Items;
Custom shortcut: double click action items and click on shortcut slot (1,2,3,4,5,6);

notes.title: Cannibal ALPHA 0.3

tags.balance_change: * Increased the drop rate of ammunition;

tags.feature: * PT-BR language option in the game (set required language in the game beginning);
* Inventory system remodeled;
* Days, months and years;
* Weather (sun and rain);
* Craft system semi-automatic;
* Possibility of converting wood in stick and leaf in liana by inventory system;
* Drone shop;
* Trap fish fishing;
* Individualized system for campfire, shelter, fishfarm and farming (key “Q”)
